title: frametrail:attributes of type "cursor"
description: Cursor overlay: a mouse pointer with click ripples, for walking through a screen recording. Overlay only. It moves along the overlay's keyframes (box motion) and clicks at the times in clicks. This schema describes the frametrail:attributes of items whose type is "cursor". On overlays, opacity, hoverStyle, zIndex and animation apply as on every overlay type. Unknown keys are allowed; writers keep them.

color.description: CSS fill colour of the pointer and its ripples.

outlineColor.description: CSS outline colour of the pointer.

clicks.description: Click times in seconds from the overlay's start. A string of numbers separated by commas, semicolons or spaces is read as well.
